cgT_update_path_findings.A_full_rebuild: MECHANICALLY_DERIVABLE: extract_tiles + fit_cgt per tile (L-BFGS-B). This is the route-A production fit.
cgT_update_path_findings.B_dirty_tiles: MECHANICALLY_DERIVABLE: extract_tiles returns per-tile gaussian membership; dirty = tiles whose teacher field changed beyond certificate validity after theta_t->theta_t+1.
cgT_update_path_findings.C_incremental_cert_reuse: MECHANICALLY_DERIVABLE: certify_tile(t_{t+1}, coeffs_{t}) checks if OLD coeffs still rigorously certify against NEW teacher; pass -> reuse (no refit). This is the cheap validity check.
cgT_update_path_findings.verdict: All three update strategies are mechanically derivable from frozen upstream code. NONE require inventing a new algorithm (satisfies TI0 sec.3).
